title: Very high and increasing RAM usage the longer AAPS runs [SOLVED]
body:
As the title says the RAM usage of the app starts with 200mb and starts increasing and increasing up to 1GB after the first day and continues until the app gets laggy and I have to restart it, all within 1 day.

I used an older version (2.6) for a long time, did an update and then the problem occured.

Built version: 2.8.2 fullrelease.
Smartphone: Redmi Note 7, MIUI 12.0.3

Logs:
[AndroidAPS._2021-02-24_00-00-06_.0.zip](https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/files/6034173/AndroidAPS._2021-02-24_00-00-06_.0.zip)

**Edit**:
Solved the problem. I restarted my phone multiple times and the ram usage stays under 100mb, no ram increase...etc.
